subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】strong 强壮的; friendly 友好的; quiet 安静的; hair 头发; shoe 鞋; glasses 眼镜
【重点句型】What's his/her name? 他/她叫什么名字？ His/Her name is ... 他/她的名字是…… He's/She's tall and ... 他/她又高又…… He has ... 他有…… He's friendly. 他很友好。
【A Let's talk】John: Mum, I have a new friend. Mum: Really? A Chinese friend? John: Yes. He's tall and strong. Mum: What's his name? John: His name is Zhang Peng.
【Read and write】I have a good friend. He is tall and strong. He has short hair and big eyes. He has glasses. He is friendly. We play together. He likes sports. His name is Mike.
key_points: What's his/her name? 他/她叫什么名字？
His/Her name is ... 他/她的名字是……
He's/She's tall and ... 他/她又高又……
